correctness.rationale: For signed K_(m,n) with m,n>=2, the signed-burning rule propagates one synchronous round then ignites one remaining vertex. With first ignition at a_i of colour +, the entire opposite shore is forced to s_ij in the next spread; the second ignition can preempt at most one same-shore vertex before the correlation wave. Unignited a_k receives sign rho_ik=sum_j s_ij s_kj; negative/positive correlations can be preempted once while zero correlations remain later independently ignitable. Hence the exact maximum is R_i=r_i^0+max(1+p_i+r_i^++1_[r_i^->0],q_i+r_i^-+1_[r_i^+>0]); swap shores for C_j and maximize. Reversing both colours accounts for either chosen target. Independently implemented signed-round recursion versus formula, exhaustively for all 16 K2,2, 64 K2,3, 64 K3,2, 256 K2,4 and 512 K3,3 signings (912 signing tests); all matched. The structural proof covers arbitrary m,n and is not inferred from finite cases.
